shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separate major panels from the workspace.

narrative.overview: A compact native work surface where media state stays legible while external tools run.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet belongs to the primary action or current work, not passive decoration.

dos: Keep task state visible in plain language.
Use native dialogs for local paths.
donts: Do not render missing metadata as zero.
Do not add controls before their engine behavior exists.
